source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 神剑暴露，怒意暗起
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC20 after EP02 SC19 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Tang Qi being kicked away into the next turn of escalation: the crowd is stunned; Keshadu's suspicion deepens; Duan Yukai praises Tuobaye; Tuobaye shows or draws the broken Wufeng/No-Edge Sword and shocks everyone; Shisilang decides to fight personally; the white-clothed woman grows quietly angry at Tuobaye's recklessness and prepares to intervene invisibly again.
title: 神剑暴露，怒意暗起

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC19 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC19 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH03 and SH04 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 拓拔野在白衣女子暗助下误打误撞踢飞唐七，众人错愕。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 唐七被踢飞后，段聿铠拍掌叫好，科沙度越发怀疑拓拔野的真实来历。拓拔野得意忘形，与十四郎针锋相对，甚至亮出无锋剑，令众人震惊。白衣女子暗中嗔怒他不知轻重，却仍被迫准备再次助他收拾残局。十四郎一面心虚忌惮，一面终于亲自下场，下一轮真正的危险逼近。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后十四郎正式与拓拔野交手，拓拔野先吃重鞭，在白衣女子暗助下又一次强行支撑，局面更加危险。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and mostly restrained; her anger should register as stillness and gaze, not overt magical spectacle.
Duan Yukai remains injured but impressed, never suddenly healed into full strength.
Shisilang remains proud, volatile, and suspicious. Keshadu remains colder and more calculating.
If the no-edge sword appears, it must feel like an alarming revelation rather than a triumphant hero shot.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the sequence readable: shock, suspicion, sword reveal, and the decision to escalate should each read as a distinct beat rather than a muddled argument scene.
